gen-gf-bellota-gf-tsukimi-rounded: Bellota draws every stroke with a single stylus width, and its s lets its ends drift wide of the spine. Tsukimi Rounded sits beside it, soft and plain sans, curves like open parentheses.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-tuffy: Tuffy looks like pencil sketched letters that never press harder, with a widely parted s. Bellota sits above in a display voice, distinctive where this sans-serif stays quiet and contemporary.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-urbanist: Commanding from the first letter, Bellota traces every stroke like a single rolling-ball trail, with an s that hangs open. And Urbanist, a sans with a broad-nibbed pen feel, never curls its curves shut.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-varela: Bellota is the showpiece, its s opening wide and every stroke traced at one stylus width. Varela handles the talking, sans-serif and approachable, with a t whose crossbar and stem match.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-wix-madefor-display: Marker-tip strokes and a wide-hanging s make Bellota instantly recognizable. Wix Madefor Display follows in plain sans form, with gently flared curve ends that stay apart, so a longer passage moves along without friction.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-wix-madefor-text: Bellota carries the flair, with no vertical emphasis and no horizontal thinning in its strokes. Wix Madefor Text, sans-serif and professional, does the quieter job, its open terminals keeping each line easy to follow.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-ysabeau-infant: Wide-hanging s, marker-like strokes, no pinched joins. Bellota supplies the flourish, and Ysabeau Infant, a sans-serif with terminals that point outward like tongs, handles the everyday reading with a friendly manner.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-ysabeau-office: Contemporary and a bit playful, Bellota draws true monoline letters. Ysabeau Office, a plain sans with open-ended curves on every letter, takes over the text so the two feel like one coherent page.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-ysabeau-sc: Ysabeau SC opens with a visibly gaping c at any size, professional and modern in tone. But Bellota holds the display role, its level beat free of weight accents, while this plain sans carries the detail.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-zalando-sans-expanded: Contemporary and clean, Zalando Sans Expanded spreads its letters with wide gaps beneath Bellota's neon-tube strokes. Zalando Sans Expanded keeps its c tips apart, so a longer stretch of this sans-serif reads like a sparse, patient row.
